{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Verify the premise that assay_batch does not affect biomarker_baseline
# Filter out sentinel values
valid_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Compute mean baseline by assay_batch
mean_by_batch = valid_df.groupby('assay_batch')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Compute standard deviation by batch to assess variability
std_by_batch = valid_df.groupby('assay_batch')['biomarker_baseline'].std()

# Check if the difference is large relative to standard deviation
# Use a simple t-test to assess significance (two-sample t-test)
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind

batch_A = valid_df[valid_df['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_baseline']
batch_B = valid_df[valid_df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_baseline']

# Perform t-test
t_stat, p_val = ttest_ind(batch_A, batch_B, equal_var=False)

print(f'Mean biomarker_baseline by assay_batch (valid data):
{mean_by_batch}')
print(f'Standard deviation by assay_batch:
{std_by_batch}')
print(f'T-test: t = {t_stat:.4f}, p = {p_val:.4f}')

# Check if the difference is meaningful
# A difference of >1 ng/mL is clinically meaningful
mean_diff = abs(mean_by_batch['A'] - mean_by_batch['B'])
print(f'Difference in means: {mean_diff:.4f} ng/mL')"}
